rules.name: no_third_party
rules.why: no one loses lp in others' calls

rules.name: deposit_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("totalSupply") - pre("totalSupply")) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) > wide(post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalSupply"))
rules.why: lp minted never exceeds the tokens actually pulled (no rounding in depositor's favour)

rules.name: deposit_pulls_something
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) <= pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: a deposit that pulls nothing must fail

rules.name: deposit_pull_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and wide(post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * 1000000000000 < arg(0) - 999999999999
rules.why: pulled tokens match amount18 up to scale rounding

rules.name: deposit_mint_sync
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and post("totalSupply") - pre("totalSupply") != post("balanceOf", sender) - pre("balanceOf", sender)

rules.name: share_price_monotone
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalSupply")) < wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(post("totalSupply"))

rules.name: withdraw_fair_custom
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalSupply")) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: transfer_conserves
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and (post_sum("balanceOf") != pre_sum("balanceOf") or post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply"))

rules.name: assets_out_only_withdraw
rules.expr: ok and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) and not called("withdraw")

rules.name: no_third_party_token_loss
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
